claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.item_kind_state
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item already has an authored form-changing activation via alter_item_kind, but the current surface cannot scope passive or reaction parts to the current form. Without that gate, Acrobatic Assist and Attack Deflection would be over-granted in the wrong forms.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only)." / "Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only)."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_weapon_property_or_returning_weapon
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current atoms can modify attack and damage rolls with a specific item, but they cannot temporarily give the weapon the Thrown property, assign its thrown ranges, or encode its immediate return to hand after the ranged attack.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "This weapon has the Thrown property with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet. Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand."
